suggested_visual_repair: Rebuild both silhouettes around a more elongated swept body-to-tail transition. For the split counter, create one visibly continuous curved tail trunk before any bifurcation, then a shallow late asymmetric notch: two unequal short rounded tips following the same sweep direction, with the secondary tip visibly subordinate. Move the notch away from the bulb and eliminate paired lobes emerging directly from the body. For the single counter, remove the drumstick-like round tail knob and blend a taper continuously into a rounded termination. Retain the required footprint, flat stack faces and minimum branch width, and rerun exact capacity/thickness checks. Obtain a fresh unprimed reviewer on corrected images; this now-primed reviewer cannot supply a new blind semantic pass.
secondary_observations_not_scope_blocker: Faint lane markings and missing heading glyph remain presentation issues.
Physical tests, rules verification, exact source authenticity and final-manual claims are outside this review.
release_recommendation: Do not treat round 1 as meeting the requested blind plasma-counter correction. Dice and bar corrections pass the visible requirements separately.
